validator.source_text:
<scxml xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2005/07/scxml" version="1.0" initial="a" datamodel="xpath">
  <datamodel><data id="items"><item/><item/></data><data id="n" expr="0"/></datamodel>
  <state id="a">
    <onentry><foreach array="$items/item" item="1st"><assign location="$n" expr="$n + 1"/></foreach></onentry>
    <transition event="go" target="b"/>
  </state>
  <final id="b"/>
</scxml>

diagnostics.message: `<foreach item>` must be a variable name, but `1st` starts with a digit
notes: `<foreach>` assigns each array element (`item`) and its position (`index`) to a variable with this name, creating it when it is not declared; the name must be a legal identifier of the `xpath` data model
diagnostics.help: use an XPath variable name: an NCName that starts with a letter or `_`, without `$` (`<foreach>` binds the variable, and expressions then refer to it as `$name`)
spec_references: SCXML CR 2014 §C.3 The XPath Data Model
